AiM 1.0.8

Open the AiM.exe beside the Application Files and Documents folders. Keep all three together.
Drop bill PDFs and their amendment instructions on the homepage.
The bill version to mark and its amendments are the only required files.
Choose an output folder once; it is remembered and remains changeable.
Marked PDFs are saved automatically when the files finish loading.
Output: AB [Bill Number] [Month Day] AMENDS IN.pdf (SB is also supported).
Click an issue to open its original amendment PDF and highlighted instruction.
Successful marks may be saved with unresolved amendments clearly reported.
Yellow margin numbers and boxed numbers identify amendment locations.
Above/below-line arrows need only the referenced printed margin number.
Blue arrows mark insertions; red lines mark strikes; plain blue lines mark
strike-and-insert instructions without arrowheads. Original PDFs stay unchanged.
Existing outputs are skipped. PDF reading, OCR and markup run locally.
Documents/PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json records every packaged file except itself.
See Documents/README.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for scope and notices.
title: AiM 1.0.8
notes:
Compound title amendments and a scrollable issue-review PDF.

- Title and heading compounds can strike a quoted portion of the first line, complete intervening lines, and a quoted portion of the last line. Every clause is resolved within its stated scope; adjacent targets merge into one source replacement.
- Missing, overlapping, ambiguous and unsupported clauses hold the whole amendment for review instead of leaving partial strikeouts. Words such as first or all occurrences inside quotes cannot choose an unrequested source occurrence.
- The review PDF scrolls continuously through the original pages. Type a page number and select Go or press Enter. Previous/next-page buttons remain available.
- Original instruction highlights stay on their pages. Only nearby pages are rendered, with at most five resident page canvases; closing the viewer cancels pending rendering and clears its canvases.
- The -0- marker still ends amendment processing, even though the original PDF pages after that marker remain available to review.

All 192 source checks passed. Controlled packaged-app tests covered numbered and unnumbered five-line title compounds, with zero changed body pixels outside requested strikeouts. An eight-page source verified typed/Enter jumps, mouse-wheel scrolling, invalid page rejection, small-window controls, highlights, bounded canvases, rapid reopening and Clear Cache. The full packaged regression also passed; six previous output PDFs matched their approved bytes exactly, with original inputs and all 356 packaged files unchanged.

Extract the complete ZIP and open AiM/AiM.exe. Keep AiM.exe, Application Files and Documents together. The published ZIP must reconstruct the exact tested manifest and checksum.
